agent_types.EnvironmentMonitor: Responsible for collecting data about the environment in which the agents operate, such as temperature, humidity, and light levels.
agent_types.TaskAssigner: Manages the distribution of tasks among the agents based on their capabilities and the current workload.
agent_types.SensorController: Controls and manages various sensors used by the agents to gather information from the environment.
agent_types.DataProcessor: Processes raw data collected by sensors and monitors to derive meaningful insights and make decisions based on this data.
agent_types.CommunicationCoordinator: Facilitates communication between different agents and external systems, ensuring that information is exchanged efficiently and effectively.
